questions.stem_md: Teng yonli $ABCD$ trapetsiyaning asoslari $BC=6$ sm va $AD=24$ sm, yon tomoni $AB=15$ sm. Trapetsiyaning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="32,174 128,46 192,46 288,174" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="128" y1="46" x2="128" y2="174" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="128,163 139,163 139,174" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="18.6" y="180.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="121.3" y="32.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="198.7" y="32.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="301.4" y="180.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="128" y="187" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">H</text><text x="160" y="33" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="160" y="187" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">24</text><text x="69.6" y="102.2" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text></svg>
figure.alt: Teng yonli ABCD trapetsiya: BC = 6 yuqori asos, AD = 24 pastki asos, AB = 15 yon tomon; B uchidan AD ga BH balandlik tushirilgan.

questions.solution_md:
$B$ uchidan balandlik tushiramiz: $BH\perp AD$. Teng yonli trapetsiyada $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{24-6}{2}=9$.

To'g'ri burchakli $ABH$ uchburchakdan: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{15^2-9^2}=12$.

Yuza: $S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot BH=\dfrac{6+24}{2}\cdot 12=180$ sm².
questions.mistake_note_md: Balandlik o'rniga yon tomonni ishlatish ($S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot AB$) yoki yuzni hisoblashda $\dfrac12$ ni unutish.

ru.stem_md: Основания равнобедренной трапеции $ABCD$ равны $BC=6$ см и $AD=24$ см, боковая сторона $AB=15$ см. Найдите площадь трапеции (в см²).

ru.solution_md:
Из вершины $B$ опустим высоту $BH\perp AD$. В равнобедренной трапеции $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{24-6}{2}=9$.

Из прямоугольного треугольника $ABH$: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{15^2-9^2}=12$.

Площадь: $S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot BH=\dfrac{6+24}{2}\cdot 12=180$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Используют боковую сторону вместо высоты ($S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot AB$) или забывают множитель $\dfrac12$.

en.solution_md:
Draw the altitude $BH\perp AD$ from $B$. In an isosceles trapezoid $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{24-6}{2}=9$.

From right triangle $ABH$: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{15^2-9^2}=12$.

Area: $S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot BH=\dfrac{6+24}{2}\cdot 12=180$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Using the leg instead of the altitude ($S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot AB$) or forgetting the factor $\dfrac12$.

questions.stem_md: Teng yonli $ABCD$ trapetsiyaning asoslari $AD=12$ sm va $BC=6$ sm, diagonallari o'zaro perpendikulyar. Trapetsiyaning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="56,188 108,32 212,32 264,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="56" y1="188" x2="212" y2="32" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="108" y1="32" x2="264" y2="188" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="166.4,77.6 172.7,84 166.4,90.4" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="44" y="197" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="99.7" y="19.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="220.3" y="19.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="276" y="197" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="160" y="19" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="160" y="201" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: Teng yonli ABCD trapetsiya: asoslari AD = 12, BC = 6; AC va BD diagonallari perpendikulyar kesishadi.

questions.solution_md:
$C$ nuqtadan $BD$ ga parallel to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazamiz; u $AD$ ning davomini $E$ nuqtada kesadi. $BCED$ parallelogramm, shuning uchun $DE=BC=6$ va $CE=BD$.

Teng yonli trapetsiyada diagonallar teng: $AC=BD=CE$. $AC\perp BD$ va $CE\parallel BD$ bo'lgani uchun $AC\perp CE$. Demak, $ACE$ — teng yonli to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak, uning gipotenuzasi $AE=12+6=18$.

Gipotenuzaga tushirilgan balandlik $\dfrac{AE}{2}=9$ — bu trapetsiyaning ham balandligi.

$S=\dfrac{12+6}{2}\cdot 9=81$ sm².
questions.mistake_note_md: Balandlikni $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$ deb olish. Diagonallar perpendikulyar bo'lsa, balandlik o'rta chiziqqa teng: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

ru.stem_md: Основания равнобедренной трапеции $ABCD$ равны $AD=12$ см и $BC=6$ см, а её диагонали взаимно перпендикулярны. Найдите площадь трапеции (в см²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="56,188 108,32 212,32 264,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="56" y1="188" x2="212" y2="32" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="108" y1="32" x2="264" y2="188" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="166.4,77.6 172.7,84 166.4,90.4" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="44" y="197" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="99.7" y="19.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="220.3" y="19.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="276" y="197" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="160" y="19" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="160" y="201" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: Равнобедренная трапеция ABCD: основания AD = 12, BC = 6; диагонали AC и BD перпендикулярны.

ru.solution_md:
Проведём через $C$ прямую, параллельную $BD$; она пересекает продолжение $AD$ в точке $E$. $BCED$ — параллелограмм, поэтому $DE=BC=6$ и $CE=BD$.

В равнобедренной трапеции диагонали равны: $AC=BD=CE$. Так как $AC\perp BD$ и $CE\parallel BD$, то $AC\perp CE$. Значит, $ACE$ — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник с гипотенузой $AE=12+6=18$.

Высота к гипотенузе равна $\dfrac{AE}{2}=9$ — это и высота трапеции.

$S=\dfrac{12+6}{2}\cdot 9=81$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Берут высоту равной $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. При перпендикулярных диагоналях высота равна средней линии: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

kaa.stem_md: Teń jambaslı $ABCD$ trapeciyanıń tiykarları $AD=12$ sm hám $BC=6$ sm, diagonalları óz ara perpendikulyar. Trapeciyanıń maydanın (sm² de) tabıń.

kaa.solution_md:
$C$ noqattan $BD$ ǵa parallel tuwrı sızıq júrgizemiz; ol $AD$ nıń dawamın $E$ noqatta kesedi. $BCED$ parallelogramm, sonlıqtan $DE=BC=6$ hám $CE=BD$.

Teń jambaslı trapeciyada diagonallar teń: $AC=BD=CE$. $AC\perp BD$ hám $CE\parallel BD$ bolǵanı ushın $AC\perp CE$. Demek, $ACE$ — teń jambaslı tuwrımúyeshli úshmúyeshlik, gipotenuzası $AE=12+6=18$.

Gipotenuzaǵa túsirilgen biyiklik $\dfrac{AE}{2}=9$ — bul trapeciyanıń da biyikligi.

en.stem_md: The bases of isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$ are $AD=12$ cm and $BC=6$ cm, and its diagonals are perpendicular. Find the area of the trapezoid (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="56,188 108,32 212,32 264,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="56" y1="188" x2="212" y2="32" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="108" y1="32" x2="264" y2="188" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="166.4,77.6 172.7,84 166.4,90.4" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="44" y="197" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="99.7" y="19.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="220.3" y="19.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="276" y="197" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="160" y="19" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">6</text><text x="160" y="201" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: Isosceles trapezoid ABCD with bases AD = 12, BC = 6 and perpendicular diagonals AC and BD.

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=6$ and $CE=BD$.

In an isosceles trapezoid the diagonals are equal: $AC=BD=CE$. Since $AC\perp BD$ and $CE\parallel BD$, we get $AC\perp CE$. So $ACE$ is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse $AE=12+6=18$.

The altitude to the hypotenuse is $\dfrac{AE}{2}=9$, and this is also the height of the trapezoid.

$S=\dfrac{12+6}{2}\cdot 9=81$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the height to be $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. When the diagonals are perpendicular the height equals the midline: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

questions.stem_md: Teng yonli $ABCD$ trapetsiyaning asoslari $AD=10$ sm va $BC=4$ sm, diagonallari o'zaro perpendikulyar. Trapetsiyaning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
$C$ nuqtadan $BD$ ga parallel to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazamiz; u $AD$ ning davomini $E$ nuqtada kesadi. $BCED$ parallelogramm, shuning uchun $DE=BC=4$ va $CE=BD$.

$S=\dfrac{10+4}{2}\cdot 7=49$ sm².

ru.solution_md:
Проведём через $C$ прямую, параллельную $BD$; она пересекает продолжение $AD$ в точке $E$. $BCED$ — параллелограмм, поэтому $DE=BC=4$ и $CE=BD$.

В равнобедренной трапеции диагонали равны: $AC=BD=CE$. Так как $AC\perp BD$ и $CE\parallel BD$, то $AC\perp CE$. Значит, $ACE$ — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник с гипотенузой $AE=10+4=14$.

Высота к гипотенузе равна $\dfrac{AE}{2}=7$ — это и высота трапеции.

$S=\dfrac{10+4}{2}\cdot 7=49$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Берут высоту равной $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. При перпендикулярных диагоналях высота равна средней линии: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

en.stem_md: The bases of isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$ are $AD=10$ cm and $BC=4$ cm, and its diagonals are perpendicular. Find the area of the trapezoid (in cm²).

figure.alt: Isosceles trapezoid ABCD with bases AD = 10, BC = 4 and perpendicular diagonals AC and BD.

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=4$ and $CE=BD$.

In an isosceles trapezoid the diagonals are equal: $AC=BD=CE$. Since $AC\perp BD$ and $CE\parallel BD$, we get $AC\perp CE$. So $ACE$ is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse $AE=10+4=14$.

The altitude to the hypotenuse is $\dfrac{AE}{2}=7$, and this is also the height of the trapezoid.

$S=\dfrac{10+4}{2}\cdot 7=49$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the height to be $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. When the diagonals are perpendicular the height equals the midline: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

questions.stem_md: Teng yonli $ABCD$ trapetsiyaning asoslari $BC=7$ sm va $AD=19$ sm, yon tomoni $AB=10$ sm. Trapetsiyaning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

$B$ uchidan balandlik tushiramiz: $BH\perp AD$. Teng yonli trapetsiyada $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{19-7}{2}=6$.

ru.solution_md:
Проведём через $C$ прямую, параллельную $BD$; она пересекает продолжение $AD$ в точке $E$. $BCED$ — параллелограмм, поэтому $DE=BC=8$ и $CE=BD$.

В равнобедренной трапеции диагонали равны: $AC=BD=CE$. Так как $AC\perp BD$ и $CE\parallel BD$, то $AC\perp CE$. Значит, $ACE$ — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник с гипотенузой $AE=16+8=24$.

Высота к гипотенузе равна $\dfrac{AE}{2}=12$ — это и высота трапеции.

$S=\dfrac{16+8}{2}\cdot 12=144$ см².

Teń jambaslı trapeciyada diagonallar teń: $AC=BD=CE$. $AC\perp BD$ hám $CE\parallel BD$ bolǵanı ushın $AC\perp CE$. Demek, $ACE$ — teń jambaslı tuwrımúyeshli úshmúyeshlik, gipotenuzası $AE=16+8=24$.

en.stem_md: The bases of isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$ are $AD=16$ cm and $BC=8$ cm, and its diagonals are perpendicular. Find the area of the trapezoid (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="56,188 108,32 212,32 264,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="56" y1="188" x2="212" y2="32" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="108" y1="32" x2="264" y2="188" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="166.4,77.6 172.7,84 166.4,90.4" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="44" y="197" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="99.7" y="19.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="220.3" y="19.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="276" y="197" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="160" y="19" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">8</text><text x="160" y="201" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">16</text></svg>
figure.alt: Isosceles trapezoid ABCD with bases AD = 16, BC = 8 and perpendicular diagonals AC and BD.

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=8$ and $CE=BD$.

In an isosceles trapezoid the diagonals are equal: $AC=BD=CE$. Since $AC\perp BD$ and $CE\parallel BD$, we get $AC\perp CE$. So $ACE$ is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse $AE=16+8=24$.

The altitude to the hypotenuse is $\dfrac{AE}{2}=12$, and this is also the height of the trapezoid.

$S=\dfrac{16+8}{2}\cdot 12=144$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the height to be $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. When the diagonals are perpendicular the height equals the midline: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

questions.stem_md: Teng yonli $ABCD$ trapetsiyaning asoslari $BC=10$ sm va $AD=16$ sm, yon tomoni $AB=5$ sm. Trapetsiyaning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
$B$ uchidan balandlik tushiramiz: $BH\perp AD$. Teng yonli trapetsiyada $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{16-10}{2}=3$.

To'g'ri burchakli $ABH$ uchburchakdan: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

en.stem_md: The bases of isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$ are $AD=14$ cm and $BC=6$ cm, and its diagonals are perpendicular. Find the area of the trapezoid (in cm²).

figure.alt: Isosceles trapezoid ABCD with bases AD = 14, BC = 6 and perpendicular diagonals AC and BD.

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=6$ and $CE=BD$.

In an isosceles trapezoid the diagonals are equal: $AC=BD=CE$. Since $AC\perp BD$ and $CE\parallel BD$, we get $AC\perp CE$. So $ACE$ is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse $AE=14+6=20$.

The altitude to the hypotenuse is $\dfrac{AE}{2}=10$, and this is also the height of the trapezoid.

$S=\dfrac{14+6}{2}\cdot 10=100$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the height to be $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. When the diagonals are perpendicular the height equals the midline: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

ru.solution_md:
Проведём через $C$ прямую, параллельную $BD$; она пересекает продолжение $AD$ в точке $E$. $BCED$ — параллелограмм, поэтому $DE=BC=6$ и $CE=BD$.

В равнобедренной трапеции диагонали равны: $AC=BD=CE$. Так как $AC\perp BD$ и $CE\parallel BD$, то $AC\perp CE$. Значит, $ACE$ — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник с гипотенузой $AE=12+6=18$.

Высота к гипотенузе равна $\dfrac{AE}{2}=9$ — это и высота трапеции.

$S=\dfrac{12+6}{2}\cdot 9=81$ см².

en.stem_md: The bases of isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$ are $AD=12$ cm and $BC=6$ cm, and its diagonals are perpendicular. Find the area of the trapezoid (in cm²).

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=6$ and $CE=BD$.

In an isosceles trapezoid the diagonals are equal: $AC=BD=CE$. Since $AC\perp BD$ and $CE\parallel BD$, we get $AC\perp CE$. So $ACE$ is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse $AE=12+6=18$.

The altitude to the hypotenuse is $\dfrac{AE}{2}=9$, and this is also the height of the trapezoid.

$S=\dfrac{12+6}{2}\cdot 9=81$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the height to be $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. When the diagonals are perpendicular the height equals the midline: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

questions.stem_md: Teng yonli $ABCD$ trapetsiyaning asoslari $BC=4$ sm va $AD=16$ sm, yon tomoni $AB=10$ sm. Trapetsiyaning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
$B$ uchidan balandlik tushiramiz: $BH\perp AD$. Teng yonli trapetsiyada $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{16-4}{2}=6$.

To'g'ri burchakli $ABH$ uchburchakdan: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{10^2-6^2}=8$.

questions.solution_md:
$C$ nuqtadan $BD$ ga parallel to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazamiz; u $AD$ ning davomini $E$ nuqtada kesadi. $BCED$ parallelogramm, shuning uchun $DE=BC=4$ va $CE=BD$.

Teng yonli trapetsiyada diagonallar teng: $AC=BD=CE$. $AC\perp BD$ va $CE\parallel BD$ bo'lgani uchun $AC\perp CE$. Demak, $ACE$ — teng yonli to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak, uning gipotenuzasi $AE=10+4=14$.

Gipotenuzaga tushirilgan balandlik $\dfrac{AE}{2}=7$ — bu trapetsiyaning ham balandligi.

$S=\dfrac{10+4}{2}\cdot 7=49$ sm².
questions.mistake_note_md: Balandlikni $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$ deb olish. Diagonallar perpendikulyar bo'lsa, balandlik o'rta chiziqqa teng: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

ru.stem_md: Основания равнобедренной трапеции $ABCD$ равны $AD=10$ см и $BC=4$ см, а её диагонали взаимно перпендикулярны. Найдите площадь трапеции (в см²).

ru.solution_md:
Проведём через $C$ прямую, параллельную $BD$; она пересекает продолжение $AD$ в точке $E$. $BCED$ — параллелограмм, поэтому $DE=BC=4$ и $CE=BD$.

В равнобедренной трапеции диагонали равны: $AC=BD=CE$. Так как $AC\perp BD$ и $CE\parallel BD$, то $AC\perp CE$. Значит, $ACE$ — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник с гипотенузой $AE=10+4=14$.

Высота к гипотенузе равна $\dfrac{AE}{2}=7$ — это и высота трапеции.

$S=\dfrac{10+4}{2}\cdot 7=49$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Берут высоту равной $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. При перпендикулярных диагоналях высота равна средней линии: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

$C$ noqattan $BD$ ǵa parallel tuwrı sızıq júrgizemiz; ol $AD$ nıń dawamın $E$ noqatta kesedi. $BCED$ parallelogramm, sonlıqtan $DE=BC=4$ hám $CE=BD$.

Teń jambaslı trapeciyada diagonallar teń: $AC=BD=CE$. $AC\perp BD$ hám $CE\parallel BD$ bolǵanı ushın $AC\perp CE$. Demek, $ACE$ — teń jambaslı tuwrımúyeshli úshmúyeshlik, gipotenuzası $AE=10+4=14$.

Gipotenuzaǵa túsirilgen biyiklik $\dfrac{AE}{2}=7$ — bul trapeciyanıń da biyikligi.

en.stem_md: The bases of isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$ are $AD=10$ cm and $BC=4$ cm, and its diagonals are perpendicular. Find the area of the trapezoid (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="48.6,188 115.4,32 204.6,32 271.4,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="48.6" y1="188" x2="204.6" y2="32" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="115.4" y1="32" x2="271.4" y2="188" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><polyline points="166.4,70.2 172.7,76.6 166.4,82.9" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="36.3" y="196.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="108" y="19" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="212" y="19" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="283.7" y="196.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="160" y="19" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="160" y="201" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">10</text></svg>
figure.alt: Isosceles trapezoid ABCD with bases AD = 10, BC = 4 and perpendicular diagonals AC and BD.

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=4$ and $CE=BD$.

In an isosceles trapezoid the diagonals are equal: $AC=BD=CE$. Since $AC\perp BD$ and $CE\parallel BD$, we get $AC\perp CE$. So $ACE$ is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse $AE=10+4=14$.

The altitude to the hypotenuse is $\dfrac{AE}{2}=7$, and this is also the height of the trapezoid.

$S=\dfrac{10+4}{2}\cdot 7=49$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the height to be $\dfrac{a-b}{2}$. When the diagonals are perpendicular the height equals the midline: $h=\dfrac{a+b}{2}$.

questions.stem_md: Teng yonli $ABCD$ trapetsiyaning asoslari $BC=8$ sm va $AD=14$ sm, yon tomoni $AB=5$ sm. Trapetsiyaning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
$B$ uchidan balandlik tushiramiz: $BH\perp AD$. Teng yonli trapetsiyada $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{14-8}{2}=3$.

To'g'ri burchakli $ABH$ uchburchakdan: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=8$ and $CE=BD$.

questions.solution_md:
$C$ nuqtadan $BD$ ga parallel to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazamiz; u $AD$ ning davomini $E$ nuqtada kesadi. $BCED$ parallelogramm, shuning uchun $DE=BC=8$ va $CE=BD$.

Teng yonli trapetsiyada diagonallar teng: $AC=BD=CE$. $AC\perp BD$ va $CE\parallel BD$ bo'lgani uchun $AC\perp CE$. Demak, $ACE$ — teng yonli to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak, uning gipotenuzasi $AE=16+8=24$.

Gipotenuzaga tushirilgan balandlik $\dfrac{AE}{2}=12$ — bu trapetsiyaning ham balandligi.

$S=\dfrac{16+8}{2}\cdot 12=144$ sm².

ru.solution_md:
Проведём через $C$ прямую, параллельную $BD$; она пересекает продолжение $AD$ в точке $E$. $BCED$ — параллелограмм, поэтому $DE=BC=8$ и $CE=BD$.

В равнобедренной трапеции диагонали равны: $AC=BD=CE$. Так как $AC\perp BD$ и $CE\parallel BD$, то $AC\perp CE$. Значит, $ACE$ — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник с гипотенузой $AE=16+8=24$.

Высота к гипотенузе равна $\dfrac{AE}{2}=12$ — это и высота трапеции.

$S=\dfrac{16+8}{2}\cdot 12=144$ см².

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=8$ and $CE=BD$.

In an isosceles trapezoid the diagonals are equal: $AC=BD=CE$. Since $AC\perp BD$ and $CE\parallel BD$, we get $AC\perp CE$. So $ACE$ is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse $AE=16+8=24$.

$S=\dfrac{16+8}{2}\cdot 12=144$ cm².

questions.stem_md: Teng yonli $ABCD$ trapetsiyaning asoslari $BC=5$ sm va $AD=11$ sm, yon tomoni $AB=5$ sm. Trapetsiyaning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

questions.solution_md:
$B$ uchidan balandlik tushiramiz: $BH\perp AD$. Teng yonli trapetsiyada $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{11-5}{2}=3$.

To'g'ri burchakli $ABH$ uchburchakdan: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

questions.solution_md:
$C$ nuqtadan $BD$ ga parallel to'g'ri chiziq o'tkazamiz; u $AD$ ning davomini $E$ nuqtada kesadi. $BCED$ parallelogramm, shuning uchun $DE=BC=6$ va $CE=BD$.

Teng yonli trapetsiyada diagonallar teng: $AC=BD=CE$. $AC\perp BD$ va $CE\parallel BD$ bo'lgani uchun $AC\perp CE$. Demak, $ACE$ — teng yonli to'g'ri burchakli uchburchak, uning gipotenuzasi $AE=14+6=20$.

Gipotenuzaga tushirilgan balandlik $\dfrac{AE}{2}=10$ — bu trapetsiyaning ham balandligi.

$S=\dfrac{14+6}{2}\cdot 10=100$ sm².

ru.solution_md:
Проведём через $C$ прямую, параллельную $BD$; она пересекает продолжение $AD$ в точке $E$. $BCED$ — параллелограмм, поэтому $DE=BC=6$ и $CE=BD$.

В равнобедренной трапеции диагонали равны: $AC=BD=CE$. Так как $AC\perp BD$ и $CE\parallel BD$, то $AC\perp CE$. Значит, $ACE$ — равнобедренный прямоугольный треугольник с гипотенузой $AE=14+6=20$.

$S=\dfrac{14+6}{2}\cdot 10=100$ см².

en.solution_md:
Draw through $C$ a line parallel to $BD$; it meets the extension of $AD$ at $E$. $BCED$ is a parallelogram, so $DE=BC=6$ and $CE=BD$.

In an isosceles trapezoid the diagonals are equal: $AC=BD=CE$. Since $AC\perp BD$ and $CE\parallel BD$, we get $AC\perp CE$. So $ACE$ is an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse $AE=14+6=20$.

questions.solution_md:
$B$ uchidan balandlik tushiramiz: $BH\perp AD$. Teng yonli trapetsiyada $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{14-8}{2}=3$.

To'g'ri burchakli $ABH$ uchburchakdan: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

Yuza: $S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot BH=\dfrac{8+14}{2}\cdot 4=44$ sm².
questions.mistake_note_md: Balandlik o'rniga yon tomonni ishlatish ($S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot AB$) yoki yuzni hisoblashda $\dfrac12$ ni unutish.

figure.alt: Isosceles trapezoid ABCD with top base BC = 8, bottom base AD = 14, leg AB = 5; the altitude BH is drawn to AD.

en.solution_md:
Draw the altitude $BH\perp AD$ from $B$. In an isosceles trapezoid $AH=\dfrac{AD-BC}{2}=\dfrac{14-8}{2}=3$.

From right triangle $ABH$: $BH=\sqrt{AB^2-AH^2}=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4$.

Area: $S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot BH=\dfrac{8+14}{2}\cdot 4=44$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Using the leg instead of the altitude ($S=\dfrac{BC+AD}{2}\cdot AB$) or forgetting the factor $\dfrac12$.
